cases.about: The pre-due retest reminder went out 3 days ago; on the due day the same retest is still cooling down.
Milestones muted: suppressed, not in the agenda, nothing recorded.
Never asked: no messages, Pi should ask once; the item still reaches the agenda.
Data category switched off, retest on: the retest is sent, the data item is not.
Three proactive messages in a row never opened: at most one a week, and Pi asks lightly next time.
The latest of the three was opened: no downshift; one sent this week is under 3.

Appendix C: week-6 checkpoint of salt reduction, the 20th check-in and the glucose retest due all land at 23:00 on 2026-08-31. Only the retest (highest priority) is sent, deferred to 08:00; the checkpoint and milestone go to the agenda. Next morning nothing new; on the due day the retest fires again after its 7-day cooldown.
Check-in from the milestone message: 20 → 21, a celebration line; the same action again changes nothing.
A check-in that reaches 20 celebrates the milestone at once; the next scan does not celebrate it again.
